nodes.label: ADR 0140: A song played pauses the analysis's reads, not only its new songs
nodes.rationale: Playing songs create disk contention on shared NAS. Rather than cancelling analysis (losing 30s of work), mark every file read with priority: playing songs get immediate reads, analysis waits 3s after the last playback read, max 2 minutes. This lets the player get the NAS immediately when needed.

nodes.label: Playback Prioritization: Playing Song Gets Disk First
nodes.rationale: ADR 0140 decision: every file GLUE Home reads is marked (local.rs Pri, Paced). Playing song marks 'playing now' with every piece read. Analysis reads wait between pieces while a song was marked in the last 3s, 2 minutes at most. When player buffer is full and stops reading, the mark ages and analysis reads on.

nodes.label: Paced Reading: local.rs Pri and Paced Mechanism
NAS Contention: Shared Disk Resource Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: ADR 0140 context: user's NAS is shared. Running analysis reads take about 30s each. Playing a song was waiting for analysis reads to finish. Solution: pause analysis reads while song plays to give disk to the player immediately.

nodes.label: ADR 0138: What the user asks for goes first
HTTP Byte-Range Streaming Alternative
nodes.rationale: Alternative considered in ADR 0140: a socket for stream transport. Rejected: browser audio player streams over HTTP with byte ranges to start and seek; the transport isn't where the time goes. NAS I/O is the bottleneck, not the protocol.

hyperedges.label: Playback Priority Flow: Playing Pauses Analysis Reads
